meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量解析和标准化分子结构,并计算描述符与指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做药物发现,需要更省事地处理分子数据
copy.tagline_en: Parse and standardize molecules in bulk, then compute descriptors and fingerprints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do drug discovery in Python and want simpler molecule handling

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 datamol 这个 Python 库处理分子:解析与标准化 SMILES、计算描述符和指纹、聚类、生成 3D 构象、读写分子文件,产出 RDKit 的 Mol 对象。
howto.when: 当你提到 SMILES、指纹、构象等关键词,或要求做分子标准化、聚类、文件读写时触发。需要 Python 3.8+ 并装上 datamol。

say.text: 把这批 SMILES 标准化,去掉金属盐并重新电离
给这些分子算描述符和 ECFP4 指纹,用全部核心并行
say.note: 走 batch 描述符与 to_fp,n_jobs=-1

say.text: 对这 1000 个分子做 Butina 聚类,cutoff 设 0.2
say.note: 调用 cluster_mols,适合约千级规模

howto.what_en: Claude uses the datamol Python library for molecules: parse and standardize SMILES, compute descriptors and fingerprints, cluster, generate 3D conformers, and read/write molecular files, returning RDKit Mol objects.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention SMILES, fingerprints, or conformers, or ask for molecule standardization, clustering, or file I/O. Needs Python 3.8+ with datamol installed.

say_en.text: Standardize these SMILES, disconnect metals and reionize
Compute descriptors and ECFP4 fingerprints for these molecules in parallel
Run Butina clustering on these 1000 molecules with cutoff 0.2
